description: Reference manifest of the M-QCD campaign (m-qcd/PLAN.md §4.2), written by tools/loop_reference/mqcd_campaign.py manifest from mqcd_campaign.json and the committed fixtures. Per row: process, pyAmpliCol route (restriction, fixed parameters), reference runs (fixture path below tests/fixtures/loop, orders, parameters, points, MadLoop accuracy per point and loop squared split order) and existing references. 'pending' marks a reference not committed yet. The pyAmpliCol request uses the fixture's parameters and fixed_parameters (the MadLoop card values).

conventions.laurent: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps = (4 pi)^eps / Gamma(1 - eps); physical couplings; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included
conventions.squared_split_orders: QCD^2, QED^2 = summed g_s and e powers of the interfering amplitudes; a loop sector's born_sector is its orders minus the correction step
conventions.madloop_accuracy: MadLoop's own estimate of the relative accuracy of a loop squared split order (ACC(i) of SLOOPMATRIX_THRES); 0.0 when its stability test found no difference
conventions.per_helicity: MadLoop SLOOPMATRIXHEL_THRES: colour average and identical-particle factor, no helicity average; HelConfigs.dat helicity labels

madloop_settings.special_points: limit-point runs (S1-S3) request 1e-20, forcing MadLoop's quadruple-precision evaluation, at points that are MadLoop's own quadruple-precision projection of their binary64 rounding (supplied_points.py --madloop-qp-point)

reference_notes.0: MadLoop quadruple precision at its own projected point (published); OpenLoops reads the binary64 rounding of the point, whose Born condition (~1e7: MadLoop's double-precision Born at the binary64 point differs from its quadruple-precision one by 1.6e-9) limits the provider comparison to ~1e-8
reference_notes.1: REFERENCE GOOD TO ~1e-6 ONLY: MadLoop's quadruple-precision evaluation is unstable (return code 420, own accuracy 1.3e-6) and OpenLoops differs by 4.3e-5; not a 1e-12 reference (rule 1 outlier without a confirming provider)
reference_notes.2: NO PROVIDER REFERENCE: MadLoop's quadruple-precision evaluation is unstable (return code 420, own accuracy 28; OneLOop: 'input does not seem to represent hard kinematics') and MadLoop, Recola and OpenLoops disagree at O(1); validate by internal oracles only

excluded_providers.recola: COLLIER double precision fails at small opening angles (1e-4 relative at theta = 1e-3)
